highlights: UGREEN CM769 Microphone for PC, USB Mic with RGB Lights, Mute Button, 24bit/96kHz, Cardioid Polar Pattern, Volume Control, Condenser Microphone for Streaming, Gaming, Podcasting, Recording

[Enhanced Sound Quality] The microphone reaches a high professional sampling rate of 96KHz/24 bit. The microphone is equipped with an intelligent DSP chip with ENC noise reduction algorithm, and the high-sensitivity microphone head cardioid tip to focus on sound, effective noise reduction and clearer sound quality. Note: When capturing audio, please stay within 1 meter of the microphone to ensure the sound quality!

[ REAL TIME LISTENING WITHOUT LATENCY] The back of the microphone is equipped with a 3.5mm audio port, allowing to open the real-time control, without delay, no need to install drivers, plug and play, so that you can more quickly grasp the sound status, to provide you with better game quality or recording of video creation. (Note: the microphone does not support speakers.)

[Wide Compatibility] This microphone is compatible with PC, PS4/PS5, Switch, iPhone 15/16 (USB C to USB C cable required), Mac, Windows, iOS and platforms such as YouTube, Skype and Zoom. The desktop upright microphone is suitable for home recording studios. It also features a standard 3/8 threaded connector on the bottom for mounting a stand (stand not included) for easy live streaming. (Note: Not compatible with Xbox)

[ Quick & Easy Setting] The microphone has an independent sensor button located on the top of the microphone, which can be used for noise cancellation and mute with one click to avoid interference. The microphone is equipped with a toggle button and sliding wheel to control the microphone volume, headphone volume and RGB lighting mode, which is easy and quick to use.

[RGB Colorful Light Effect] The microphone has 7 RGB light effects, including ghost light effect, 5 monochrome lights and seven color breathing light, which add a unique mood to your recording environment. Whether you're streaming live or recording videos, these light effects create amazing visual effects that enhance the viewer's viewing experience.
